longest_sentences: Cuervo's streets, blocks and additions remained part of the language used to describe land long after many of its commercial functions had gone.
A person could attend school in Santa Rosa, work across a wider area and retain a home or other connection near Cuervo.
A school record from another town cannot automatically be coded as departure, and a business connection cannot automatically be coded as residence.
Studies of former mining communities likewise distinguish the appearance of a place from the ways people continue to use and understand it.
For anyone thinking about the future of a small settlement, this is a reason to examine arrangements rather than count buildings alone.
It illustrates why the absence of an old village storefront cannot establish the disappearance of all trade associated with the locality.
Together, the records establish several kinds of continuing relationship: restoration involvement, an announced service, institutional affiliation and a later financial entry.
The historical record does not identify a redevelopment plan, calculate its costs or establish the wishes of present residents and owners.
